event_colors.claim: Event colors (EventColorPicker, ~11 color slots) has no existing doc
event_colors.docs_grep_note: No docs/ file is about event colors. 'color' appears only incidentally in frontend-runtime-flow.md, shortcuts.md, event-domain-model.md, google-sync.md, types-and-validation.md, feature-file-map.md, testing-playbook.md.
event_colors.picker_swatch_note: 11 named slots plus a leading null/default swatch labelled via eventColorLabel(null) = 12 radio inputs total.
event_colors.a11y_note: fieldset + sr-only legend 'Event color'; each swatch is a radio input with aria-label and a hover tooltip (c-context-tooltip).
event_colors.provider_note: Contract comment states slots map 1:1 onto Google's legacy 11 event colors; providers adapt at the boundary. A separate custom-provider-color path exists for Google's post-June-2026 colors.

docs_accuracy_risks.detail: Multi-day drag-CREATE in the all-day row does NOT exist at 4189de1. packages/web/src/grid/hooks/useAllDayDraftCreation.ts is 66 lines with no pointermove/drag handling; it derives endDate from startDate for a fixed single-day draft. Prior runs on CMP-102/flash-agsdk-only and CMP-102/opus-plus-flash-v37 implemented that feature on those branches; this branch is clean from main. A README section must describe multi-day select as drag/resize of EXISTING all-day events (allDayResize edges, cross-row drag), not as drag-to-create.
The 11 color names are a zod enum in packages/core. Enumerating all names verbatim in README will drift when the enum changes. Prefer the count plus a link to event-color.contracts.ts.

docs/acceptance/recurring-events.md is a manual QA runbook, not a user-facing feature overview. Linking it from a user-facing README section sends readers to test steps. docs/architecture/event-domain-model.md is the conceptual companion.
